reports.name: desktop
reports.note: WarpDiff does not convert audio in the browser. With FFmpeg installed separately, run the copied command in a macOS or Linux terminal from the folder containing the original file. The command makes a stereo AAC copy and pads a short soundtrack to retain the complete video; keep the original for multichannel or original-source measurements. Then use Load (L) or drag and drop to load the _aac output together with the other files in your comparison. Loading files starts a new comparison.
